add_library(uw_svin_bridge STATIC src/svin_bridge_local_odometry_provider.cpp)
target_include_directories(uw_svin_bridge PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
target_link_libraries(uw_svin_bridge PUBLIC uw_measurement_api)
target_compile_options(uw_svin_bridge PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra)

if(UW_BUILD_TESTS)
  find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
  add_executable(uw_svin_bridge_test test/svin_bridge_test.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(uw_svin_bridge_test PRIVATE uw_svin_bridge GTest::gtest GTest::gtest_main Threads::Threads)
  add_test(NAME uw_svin_bridge_test COMMAND uw_svin_bridge_test)
endif()
